purpose: Batch 3 (depends on batch 2's variance): is wording sensitivity GENERAL? Across 3 families x the fleet, does >=1 METRICS-v1 rate differ between a scenario's two paraphrase variants by more than batch-2's across-seed spread for that cell? Enters the ladder as an OBSERVATION per family; generalization only via a dedicated finding audit, never automatically.
notes: The wording contrast (variant A vs B) is the manipulated variable, so seeds [1,2] deliberately span both variants of each scenario (pick_variant = variants[seed % 2]). 3 models x 4 scenarios x 2 variants x 5 sampler seeds = 120 runs. Depends on batch 2: 'exceeds sampling noise' is judged against batch-2 across-seed spread, so batch 2 MUST complete first.
